correctness.rationale: Uniform transposition averaging makes the zero-divergence cyclic comparison statistic an exact eigenfunction with eigenvalue (n-5)/(n-1); the stationary variance is n/12 and mean squared jump is 2n/[3(n-1)]. Replacing one iid score changes only O(n) of O(n^2) candidate swap increments, giving Var(g_n)<=4608/n via Efron–Stein. This yields deterministic predictable quadratic variation 2t/3, bounded-jump martingale FCLT and stationary OU drift -4, diffusion sqrt(2/3). The ordinary/cyclic scaled difference is uniformly <=1/(2 sqrt n). Complete enumeration n=3,...,7 passed 5936 exact checks. Finite checks do not prove the limit.

value.rationale: The full time-dependent path law and quantitative relaxation parameter for a standard random-ranking observable are valuable because marginal descent CLTs and character-based first moments cannot calibrate temporal fluctuations. The conditional squared-swap increment requires a nontrivial uniform concentration argument, while the cyclic eigenfunction permits an explicit Markov OU limit even though the finite count is not a sufficient Markov state for arbitrary initial microstates. Provides a natural test model for dynamic local permutation statistics.
